GoogleDrive._comment: The app's built-in Google OAuth client for one-click Drive authorization. Leave blank here and set real values via 'dotnet user-secrets' (dev) or an environment overlay (prod) — do not commit secrets. When blank, the connection editor's Advanced 'use my own OAuth client' fields are used instead.

Version._comment: The release Major.Minor for the versioning scheme Major.Minor.Build. These are the source of truth for CI builds, which apply the build number as {Major}.{Minor}.{build}. Local builds override this: a plain build/run is baked as 0.0.0-dev, and the Install publish profile bakes 0.0.{buildnumber.txt}-published. The full version is baked into the executable and read back at runtime (see BuildInfo).
